feeds.title: CML Distribution
feeds.description: CML Distribution are the leading supplier of radio control models and hobby products in the UK. Our range includes rc cars, aircraft, helicopters and boats. Follow this blog and stay tuned to everything RC.

feeds.title: Slope Soaring Sussex
feeds.description: Slope Soaring Sussex is a BMFA flying club run by local group of radio controlled model flyers to promote and encourage RC glider flying in Sussex. Keep up with news and updates by subscribing this blog.

feeds.title: RC-SOAR
feeds.description: Mike Shellim's blog about radio control systems and gliders, with occasional discussion on photography and computers. Read about various product reviews, and much more about radio control systems in his blog.

feeds.title: RC Car Builds and Modifications
feeds.description: Finest Radio Controlled Cars Kits To Build Yourself For Beginners And Enthusiasts. RC Car Styling, modification with hints and tips for your build. My name is Mr. B. I have been into RC car for more than 30 years. When I buy a new RC Car, I will share my experience's with you. I do enjoy building, painting and recording the details to pass on to other experienced builders, and maybe a useful time saving tip or two for the new builder.

feeds.title: Dane-RC Blog
feeds.description: The Dane RC blog portrays model aircrafts built by the customers who purchased the RC products. Dane RC started as a small hobby project with the reintroduction of the famous Leprechaun glider. The interest in the Leprechaun model building kit ignited our passion for other model building kits, and today Dane RC offers many different model building kits, with the addition of motors, airfoils and other accessories.

feeds.title: RCM&E Magazine
feeds.description: Radio Control Models and Electronics first appeared in May 1960 and has grown to become the UK's biggest and best-selling monthly R/C model flying magazine with a large worldwide readership. The magazine has brought benchmark levels of writing and photography to the hobby and each issue has extensive reviews, informative features and opinionated columns from a number of well known contributors.

feeds.title: RC Racer
feeds.description: The UK's leading magazine for radio controlled car racers and enthusiasts. News, reviews & how to guides every month.

feeds.title: British Radio Car Association
feeds.description: BRCA - British Radio Car Association is the UK's governing body for radio controlled model car racing. Learn about what we do and how you can get involved. Check out our website to know more about radio controlled car racing.

feeds.title: RaceCraft R/C
feeds.description: Stay updated with news of new products, race results and updates from Racecraft R/C. RaceCraft R/C is a family run traditional model shop based down in the South West in Bath, on the edge of the Cotswold hills.

feeds.title: RC Geeks Blog
feeds.description: RC Geeks is the foremost retailer of remote control quadcopters, aerial photography systems, FPV equipment and RC cars. RC Geeks stocks 1000's of products including models, batteries, chargers, first person view equipment, radio gear, servos, spares, action cameras, bodyshells and more. Keep up-to-date with the world of gadgets, drones and cars.

feeds.title: Electric RC Toys Blog
feeds.description: Electric RC toys are the best supplier of electric RC toys. Subscribe to keep up with latest articles from this blog.
